'''B-4R5-GE3''' was a [[GE3-series protocol droid]] working for [[Vogga]] the Hutt on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3951 BBY]].

==Biography==
The droid monitored the transponder codes of all ships leaving the docks, then transmitted departure information for any of Vogga's [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. [[T3-M4]], the droid of [[Meetra Surik]], stole transponder codes from him so the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' would be stolen by [[G0-T0]].
